book.name: Romanos
book.title: CART DANꞋ BZOJ POSTLW SAN PABLO C̱HE BEṈEꞋ CAꞋ ŽE' ROMA

content: Cheyaḻa' cue' yic̱hjcho beṉe' ḻježcho

Baḻcho ba zoac̱hac̱hcho chejnilaže'cho Criston' na' ṉezecho de latje ye'ej gagwcho bite'teze. Perw cheyaḻa' gapcho yeḻa' chxenḻaže' len beṉe' biṉa' yesejni'išagüe'de', na' bi goncho con da' žan c̱hecho.
To tocho cheyaḻa' goncho bi da' güen da' chazlaže' beṉe' ḻježcho ca' goncho, cont gaclenen ḻegaque' yesejnilaže'che' Diosen'.

Goncho ca', ḻe ṉe Criston' bi bene' con da' gwnazen c̱he', san goc c̱he' can' nyoj Xtiža' Diosen', žan gože' X̱e' Diosen': “Beṉe' besegue'ede' le' na' goseṉe' diža' bya' c̱hio', lencze c̱hia' neda' goseṉe'.”

Na' Xtiža' Diosen' da' bosozoj beṉe' cani' chzejni'in chio' cont gwyo gwc̱hejcho šejnilaže'cho Diosen' cate' chzaca'zi'cho. Na' še goncho xbab can' žanṉa', na' gaclenchen chio' cont soacho lez gwžin ža gon Diosen' güen len chio'.
Diosen' choṉe' chio' yeḻa' chxenḻaže' cont chyo chc̱hejcho cate' chzaca'zi'cho. Na' chṉablaža' ḻecze gone' gac yic̱hjlažda'ole toze tole yetole, con can' chazlaže' Cristo Jesúsen'.
Na' gone' ca' cont toze can' ṉale gonxenḻe Dios ben' nac X̱a X̱ancho Jesucriston'.
Diosen' chaclaže' beṉe' bi zjanac beṉe' Israel yesonxene' ḻe'
Da'nan' cheyaḻa' le'e to to beṉe' ḻježcho binḻo ca Criston' chle'ede' to to chio' binḻo, chio' chejnilaže'chone'. Goncho ca' cont gacxen Diosen'.

Can' goc len Cristo Jesúsen', bzex̱jw yic̱hje' ben cuine' ca to beṉe' güen žin cont goclene' neto' beṉe' Israel. Blo'ede' diža' ḻi be' Diosen' cate' gože' da' x̱ozxta'oto' ca' gone' güen len ḻegaque'.
Na' ḻecze bid Criston' cont le'e bi nacle beṉe' Israel ḻecze gonxenḻe Diosen' da' ba beyaše'laže'de' le'e. Chac ca nyoj Xtiža' Diosen' dan' žan:

content.text: Da'nan' gua' yeḻa' chox̱clen c̱hio' gan' že beṉe' bi zjanac beṉe' Israel,

content: Na' ga yoble žan:

content.text: Le'e bi nacle beṉe' Israel, ḻe yebe txen len neto' beṉe' gwlej Diosen' nacto' nación c̱he'.

content: Na' ḻecze žan:

content.text: Yogo' le'e bi nacle beṉe' Israel, ḻe gonxen X̱ancho Diosen'.
Yogo'ḻoḻle ḻe güe' diža' c̱he yeḻa' gwnabia' c̱he'.

content: Na' da' Isaías ben' be' xtiža' Diosen' cani' bzoje' da' nga žan:

content.text: To beṉe' gualaž yide', beṉe' galje' ḻo diaža c̱he da' Isaí.
Ḻe' ṉabi'e beṉe' že' to to yež na' to to nación,
na' beṉe' ca' bi zjanac beṉe' Israel yesebeze' gaclene' ḻegaque'.

content: Diosen' chone' cont chebecho dan' ṉezecho šjayzoacho len ḻe'. Na' chṉaba' gonšque' cont soale mbalaz juisyw na' soa cuezle binḻo len xbab da' yo'o yic̱hjlažda'olen' da' zoale chejnilaže'le Criston'. Gonšque' ca' cont Spiritw c̱he Diosen' gaclenen le'e soac̱hac̱hle yebele da' ṉezele šjayzoale len ḻe'.
Beṉe' migw, ṉezda' ba nacle beṉe' šagüe' beṉe' chon da' güen, na' ṉezda' chejni'ichgüele na' chac chṉeyoe ḻježle.
Pero ḻe'e cart nga ba beyaxjda' gwdiḻa' le'e cont gonchle xbab, ḻe Diosen' beži'ilaže'de' neda' gwleje' neda'.

Gwleje' neda' cont chyix̱jue'eda' xtižen' len beṉe' bi zjanac beṉe' Israel. Na' Diosen' yebede' da' ba goclena' ḻegaque' cont baḻe' gosejḻe'e xtižen' na' gosaque' ḻo ne'e cate' Spiritw c̱hen' benen lažda'ogaquen' xilaže'.
Chbeda' chona' xšin Diosen' da' ba goclen Cristo Jesúsen' neda' chona'.

Bi cheyaxjda' gua' diža' c̱he bi da' ba ben beṉe' yoble, san choa' diža' c̱he da' ba ben Criston', ḻe chaclene' neda' choa' xtižen' na' bichle da' chona' cont zan beṉe' ca' bi zjanac beṉe' Israel chosozenague' c̱he'.

Spiritw c̱he Diosen' goclenen neda' cont bena' yeḻa' guac na' bichle da' besyebane beṉe' gate'teze gwya'a be'lena' ḻegaque' xtiža' Diosen', gwzolagua' Jerusalén na' bžintia' gan' nzi' Ilírico. Na' ba gwdix̱jue'eda' xtižen' doxen gan' gwseḻe' neda'.
Na' ba bena' byen ba bia' diža' güen da' chzejni'in c̱he Criston' gan' nono ṉa' šejnilaže'ne', ḻe bi chaclaža' tia' gwḻana' xḻatje beṉe' ba chosozejni'ide' xtiža' Diosen'.
Da'nan' chac can' nyoj Xtiža' Diosen' žan:

content.text: Beṉe' ca' biṉa' yesende' xtižen' yesombi'ene',
na' beṉe' ca' biṉa' yeseṉezde' c̱he' yesejni'ide' c̱he'.

content: Pablon' šeje' Roma
Da' chzejni'ida' beṉe' ga yoble xtiža' Criston', da'nan' bi goc yida' gan' zoalen' ḻa'czḻa' zan ṉi'a ba goclaža' yida'.
Cana'te zelaža' yedeṉa'a le'e, perw ṉa'ach ba beyož bena' da' gwlo'o Diosen' ḻo na' gona' do nga.
Nach cate' ša'a España cana' chacda' tia' yedeṉa'a le'e. Na' mbalaz soa' yeyož le'eda' le'e na' gaclenḻe neda' cate' ša'a Españan'.
Ṉa'a ša'a Jerusalén šjasana' mechw da' gaclenen beṉe' ḻježcho ca' že' na' beṉe' ca' ba gwlej Diosen' chesejnilaže'ne'.
Ḻe beṉe' ḻježchon' že' yež ca' zjachi' distritw Macedonia na' Acayan' bosotobe' mechw da' gaclenen beṉe' ḻježcho ca' chesejnilaže' Diosen' Jerusalén ben' zjanac beṉe' yaše'.

Beṉe' ca' bosotoben' besyebede' bosonežjue' mechon', na' naquen to goclen da' cheyaḻa' yesone' len beṉe' Israel gualaž c̱heto' ca', ḻe ḻa'czḻa' ḻegaque' bi zjanaque' beṉe' Israel, ba zjanone' c̱hegaque' yogo' da' güen da' ba bzejni'i Diosen' neto' beṉe' Israel, na' da'nan' cheyaḻa'cze yesaclene' beṉe' gualaž c̱heto' ca' len da' cheseyažjde'.
Cate' bac̱h beyož bena' ḻo na' beṉe' Jerusalén ca' mechon' bdoben', cana'ch sa'a ša'a Españan' na' tia' ṉa'a le'e.
Na' ṉezda' Criston' gaclene' neda' la'a gan' zoalen' cont güe'lena' le'e diža' güen c̱he' da' gaclenen yic̱hjlažda'olen' na' soachguacho mba.

Beṉe' migw, ṉezda' chaquele X̱ancho Jesucriston' can' chacda'ne' neda', na' Spiritw c̱he Diosen' chonen cont chaque ḻježcho tocho yetocho. Da'nan', beṉe' migw, chṉaba' gacle neda' txen yoḻ güižcho Diosen' cont gaclene' neda'.

Ṉabechone' bi gaca' ḻo na' beṉe' gualaž c̱heto' ca' beṉe' bi chesejnilaže' Criston' Judean', na' ḻecze ṉabechone' cont beṉe' ḻježcho ca' že' Jerusalén beṉe' yo'o ḻo na' Diosen' yesazlaže' ca dan' güe'gaca'ne'.
Nach še Diosen' goṉe' latje, mbalaz yedeṉa'a le'e na' yeyaclaža' soa' na' len le'e.
Dios ben' chon chzoa chbezcho binḻo len xbab da' yo'o ḻo' yic̱hjlažda'ochon' gaclene' yogo'le len xbab c̱helen'. Ca'šcacze gac.
